chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, who said:

Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: The most beloved time to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is its earliest part, when the time of the salat (prayer) begins. So perform the obligatory prayer; and if you do not do so, then you remain within the time of the two of them until the sun sets.

key_terms.أَوَّلُهُ: its earliest portion, at the beginning of entry
key_terms.تَغِيبَ ٱلشَّمْسُ: the sun sets, marking the end of this shared period
key_terms.مِنْهُمَا: of the two prayers, meaning Zuhr and 'Asr
key_terms.وَقْتُ ٱلصَّلَاةِ: the legally designated time of the salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلْوَقْتِ: the time appointed for the prayer

ai.seo_question: When is the best time to perform Zuhr and 'Asr prayer according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the earliest part of the prayer time is the most beloved to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. It also indicates that the time for Zuhr and 'Asr extends jointly until sunset, while emphasizing the merit of performing the obligatory salat (prayer) at the beginning of its time.
